context_for_next_testing_agent: GDL × Pebbles is a NEW 12-slide boardroom-quality executive presentation. Routes: /proposals/preview/gdl-pebbles (no auth), /proposals/gdl-pebbles (email gate). All data hardcoded in GDLPebblesPresentation.jsx. Features: Pebbles logo (P circle + text), GDL logo (red with underline), CSS-only animations with staggered reveals (via gdl-anim-* classes and data-active attribute), counter animations (1.2s duration), full keyboard/touch navigation, vertical slide transitions using translateY, progress bar at bottom. Color palette: GDL Crimson #B03140, Pebbles Dark #0A1628, Pebbles Teal #1D9E75. Prepared for Kola Ayeye, GCEO.
